en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a war memorial statue in a town square. The monument consists of a tall pedestal surrounded by an ornate metal fence, topped by a soldier holding a rifle and a large flag. Around the square are traditional European townhouses and shops with German signage. Red printed text at the top reads "Penig." on the left and "Kriegerdenkmal." on the right; small red printer's text appears at the bottom edge.
